questions.stem: How are glucose and amino acids absorbed from the small intestine into the blood?

options.text: By osmosis through the cell membranes
By active transport and diffusion into the blood capillaries
By being pumped through the villi walls by peristalsis
By being carried by white blood cells

questions.explanation: Glucose and amino acids are absorbed into the blood capillaries of the villi by a combination of diffusion (down a concentration gradient) and active transport (against a concentration gradient).
